OWNERSHIP AUDIT — v1.8 RECOVERY CANDIDATE

CONFIRMED
- AOS -> CONDUCTOR: predecessor/superseded identity.
- Historical HEIMDALL media-center ownership -> SKALD.
- Books/Reading specialist -> LECTOR.
- Professional photography -> CURATOR.
- LCAS Apps/edenOS runtime -> retired; Chat UI identity retained.
- Current HEIMDALL differs materially from historical HEIMDALL.

RESERVED, NOT MISSING

- Tiny Helpers: some intentionally have no defined need beyond name/description.

STILL REQUIRES OWNERSHIP SWEEP
Historical HEIMDALL material concerning generic documents, universal conversion, GIS/maps, medical/DICOM, scientific datasets, ingestion/indexing, offline knowledge packs, storage/file management and other cross-domain functions must be checked against newer specialist/shared-capability decisions before assigning current ownership. Do not automatically restore them to HEIMDALL.

EVIDENCE RULE
Recovered decision != implemented capability != verified working software. UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN where runtime/build evidence is absent.
